definitions.explanation: The first day of the weekend. The kanji 土 means 'earth/soil' and relates to Saturn (the 'earth planet' in East Asian tradition).

examples.japanese: {土曜日|どようび}に{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}きます。
{土曜日|どようび}は{何|なに}をしますか。
examples.english: What do you do on Saturday?

examples.japanese: {土曜日|どようび}の{朝|あさ}は{ゆっくり}します。
examples.english: I take it easy on Saturday morning.

notes:
Saturday uses 土 (earth), corresponding to the planet Saturn. Can be abbreviated to 土曜 (doyou).

Note: Don't confuse with 土用 (doyou), which refers to the seasonal period before each equinox/solstice.
